neighbours.label: a slot where a refusal / unwillingness word is about to come ('unable or [unwilling]', 'has so far [refused]')
fire: The landlord was either unable or unwilling to repair the broken heater.
So far the minister has refused every request for an interview.
Many patients cannot or will not take the medication as prescribed.
The council has so far declined to comment on the leaked report.
Some witnesses were unable or unwilling to describe what they saw.
Despite the pressure, the company has thus far refused to recall the cars.
Parents who can't or won't pay the fees are turned away at the gate.
The regime has so far rejected all offers of foreign mediation.
quiet: The landlord was both quick and careful when he repaired the broken heater.
So far the minister has answered every request for an interview.
Many patients take the medication exactly as prescribed by their doctor.
The council has so far published two updates on the leaked report.
Some witnesses were eager and able to describe what they saw.
Despite the pressure, the company has thus far sold more cars than ever.
Parents who pay the fees on time receive a small discount each term.
The regime has so far accepted two offers of foreign mediation.

notes: Card: top peaks ' or' in 'can't or don't', 'unable or unwilling', ' far' in 'has so far refused'; the + pole's logit effect suppresses refuse/refusal/reluctant/unwilling, so the - pole promotes them.
